## Breadboard topology (always true)
- Columns 1-50. Holes a1-e1 share one node; f1-j1 share another node (center channel divides them).
- Same rule for every column: a-e connected together, f-j connected together.
- To connect top half (a-e) to bottom half (f-j) of the SAME column, you MUST add a wire.
- tp = positive top rail (+9V), tn = negative top rail (GND).
- bn = positive bottom rail (+9V), bp = negative bottom rail (GND).
- Rails are NOT connected to body rows — you must wire from rail to a body hole explicitly.
- 700 holes total: 50 columns × 14 rows.
request.userMsg: Build a single LED circuit with a current-limiting resistor.

reply: Built a single-LED circuit: BAT1 feeds the +9V rail (tp_50) and GND rail (tn_50), with a resistor spanning b2–b6 and an LED with its anode at c6 and cathode at c8. Current flows from tp_3 → a2 → through the resistor → into the LED anode at c6 → out the cathode at c8 → a8 → tn_8 back to ground. The resistor limits the current so the LED lights up safely without burning out.
